Its to the very north of stockholm, be aware that there are 2 fleets with the exact appearance, but one doesnt drop the book, the formation is 1 large galleon, 3 battle galleons, they drop gold bars and gunnery guide, so if you get something else while plundering is not the fleet you are looking for, IIRC, when i got the book i got it from the fleet you can attack, but there are another 2 fleets that are surprise attack only and drops Loki's goblet and Thorstein the Red's armour.

Hope this helped

comments.author: Cash
comments.body:
Okay so after a long grind port hopping for Graphite, Iron Ore, Coal to fab the spears from spear training beginners, advanced and secrets, one can finally start strengthening these through this book but wait... you need to craft the Great Warriors spear first which requires sand and more steel... You will no doubt have some failed attempts so GL!

You will also need to have all 4 Oxford production skills boosts on and the oxford item improving skill plus an iron heart.. I recommend max casting and workshop on your boat plus magician tarot equipped for maximum results.

At Casting R15 +2 and no workshop or tarot got me approx one 100 attack spear per 35 attempts thereabouts.. I have slowly found some what of a pattern as to the failures but is not perfect and still very frustrating.

I would recommend to make 30 at a time and the ones that do start to get high enough attack (over 70) to be careful not to burn them up. If you start running low on spears to strengthen and you have a few higher attack ones.. Stop and repeat the entire process and re-load with more spears to keep a 'Buffer' of lower attack ones to burn/sacrifice while trying to get the few maxed. Kinda hard to explain but I hope this helps a bit for anyone wanting to try their hand at making on these 100 attack spears..

comments.author: Argy
comments.body:
The fleets are above Kokkola, in the northern end of the baltic sea.

You will have to grind through a few small viking fleets to get to the bigger fleet with black sails and vikings crest. Like Ming Mei said, more common loot is the gunnery guide.
